target_customer: Data, risk, media monitoring and enterprise teams (banks, PR firms, investment firms, research and government groups) that pay for structured news and web data; the company states 100 plus paying customers
problem: Monitoring global news in many languages as structured, deduplicated data is hard to build. NewsCatcher indexes news and web sources and exposes them as APIs and monitors.
business_model: Usage and tier based API subscriptions, with enterprise contracts
product_category: News and web data API (later a web search agent)

founders.name: Artem Bugara
prior_employers: Large aviation, energy and space insurance underwriter (unnamed, led a team of data engineers)
education: Econometrics degree, Toulouse School of Economics

founders.name: Maksym Sugonyaka
prior_employers: Unnamed employer for about a year
education: Master's in data science and finance, Paris Sorbonne
founders.background_notes: From the YC company page; describes himself as a self taught data engineer.

competitors.name: AYLIEN News API
competitors.what: Search, stream and analyze web news with NLP
competitors.traction_then: News API launched publicly in April 2016
competitors.funding_then: Raised 580,000 euros in March 2016 from SOSV and Enterprise Ireland per an Irish government timeline; later rounds undated in my sources

technical_complexity.rationale: Crawling and indexing tens of thousands of sources, language detection, deduplication into stories and entity resolution at scale is demanding data engineering for two founders.

defensibility.rationale: Crawled data and source coverage compound a little, but many news APIs existed and the underlying articles are public.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Aylien was reportedly acquired by Quantexa in February 2023 (one search summary); NewsCatcher stayed independent and moved toward enterprise, per its roadmap page.

market_need_then: Companies wanted news as structured data for risk and monitoring; the YC launch post lists risk intelligence, in app news and media monitoring as top use cases.

branding.domain_note: Uses newscatcherapi.com, not newscatcher.com; no history found.

identity.logo: SVG logo on the site; design not described by sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident, urgent: What you don't know can hurt you

branding.community_and_virality: Free tier and non commercial program, G2 and directory listings; no merch or fan content found.

brand_strength.rationale: Intuitive name for the product but generic, with an API suffix domain and little brand press found.

pivots.from: News API v2 for startups and developers
pivots.to: v3 and enterprise focus, then a web search agent
pivots.why: The company roadmap page says v2 is being shut down to focus on v3 and large enterprise clients; the exact date is not stated.

outcome_analysis: NewsCatcher began as a data side project in 2020, joined YC in Summer 2022 and took backing from YC and TinySeed. By 2023 and 2024 it reports enterprise and government customers and 100 plus paying customers, with a team of about 22 and a shift from the v2 developer API to enterprise and an agent product. No exit, shutdown or later priced round was found, so it looks like a small profitable style business with undisclosed economics.
notes: Funding amount conflicts: SeedTable and VCBacked list a $500K pre-seed in July 2022, another source says $1.5M seed with YC, TinySeed and Uncommon Capital, and a founder Demo Day remark cited by a profile suggests about $450K; all aggregator or profile sources, so the round amount is left null. The company page confirms YC and TinySeed backing without amounts. A YesPress profile gives a Telegram chat naming anecdote that I could not tie to the brand name, so name_origin is null. The company founding year is 2020 per profiles. Competitor source is dated 2017 and shows Aylien existed years before the batch.
